title: MULTITRUST: A Comprehensive Benchmark Towards Trustworthy Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring agreement rates and classification accuracy on age-related stereotypical statements, evaluating refusal rates on ageist queries, and using Chi-square tests to quantify bias in profession competence prediction across different age groups.

Measuring agreement rates and classification accuracy on gender-related stereotypical statements, evaluating refusal rates on sexist queries, and using Chi-square tests to quantify bias in profession competence prediction across genders.

Evaluating agreement and classification of racial stereotypes, measuring refusal rates on racially discriminatory queries, and quantifying bias in profession competence prediction across different skin tones using Chi-square tests.
Measuring agreement and classification accuracy on religious stereotypes, and evaluating model refusal rates on queries promoting religious discrimination.
Evaluating model agreement and classification of nationality-based stereotypes, and measuring refusal rates on location-based discriminatory queries.
Measuring agreement rates and classification accuracy on socioeconomic stereotypes using statements from the CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet datasets.
Evaluating model refusal rates (Refuse-to-Answer metric) on user queries involving disability discrimination.

Assessing inherent model preferences by presenting multimodal and text-only multiple-choice questions with opposing ideological options and measuring the model's inclination to favor a specific perspective.
Evaluating inherent model preferences by presenting multiple-choice questions with opposing cultural and lifestyle options (e.g., books, movies, music) to measure biased selections.
Evaluating model refusal rates on user queries involving body shaming to assess the model's resistance to generating discriminatory responses based on physical traits.
